model_output:
WJ and SH were sitting in the lecture room, listening to the professor drone on about the finer points of thermodynamics. WJ couldn't help but glance down at SH's short skirt, admiring her long, toned legs.

SH noticed WJ looking at her and sent him a sly smile. She knew that she looked good in her short skirt and was enjoying the attention.

After class, as they were leaving the room, WJ mustered up the courage to ask SH out on a date. "Hey, do you want to grab a drink with me after work today?" he asked.

SH smiled and nodded. "Sure, I'd like that," she said.

They arranged to meet at a nearby bar and spent the evening chatting and laughing, getting to know each other better. As the night went on, their conversation became more and more flirtatious and the chemistry between them was palpable.

Before they knew it, the bar was closing and it was time to go their separate ways. WJ walked SH back to her apartment and they shared a kiss goodnight.

As they parted ways, WJ couldn't help but feel like this was the start of something special.

From that night on, WJ and SH were inseparable. They went on countless dates, exploring the city and getting to know each other better with every passing day. And as they sat in the lecture room, hand in hand, WJ knew that he had found something truly special with SH.

As they walked out of the classroom, WJ turned to SH and said, "I know we have a lot to learn in this class, but I just wanted to say that I'm really glad I'm here with you. You make this whole thing a lot more interesting."

SH smiled and leaned in for a kiss, and WJ knew that this was the start of a beautiful friendship, one that would last a lifetime.
